test_title: PYST 33: SSC CGL 2022 - General Awareness(Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: In June 2022, AGNIPATH scheme was launched by the central government for which of the following purposes?

options.text: Recruitment of youth in the Armed Forces
Popularising the use of non-plastic alternatives
Sustainable and inclusive development of metro cities
Providing house facilities to tea garden workers

solution:
The correct answer is __**Recruitment of youth in the Armed Forces**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Centre has cleared the AGNIPATH Scheme for recruitment of youth in the armed forces.
 
• The youth selected under this scheme will be known as Agniveers.
 
• They will be getting an attractive monthly package with risk and hardship allowances as applicable in the three services.
 
• They will be also paid a one-time Seva Nidhi Package upon completion of the engagement period of four years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• ​‘Agniveers’will form a distinct rank in the three services, and will also wear a distinct insignia as part of their uniform.
 
• The ‘Agnipath’ model envisages the recruitment of personnel below officer rank (PBOR) in the army, air force and navy for four years, including six months of training.
 
• The soldiers recruited under ‘Agnipath’ will be released from service after four years, though the new system will have a provision for retaining around 25% of them after another round of screening.
